story_summary: A charismatic street hero and his spirited partner engage in a dazzling dance-off on the vibrant streets of Chennai. Their playful taunts and flirtatious moves escalate into a joyous, cinematic celebration of their electrifying connection under a golden-hour sunset.

characters.name: Maari
characters.visual_design: Charismatic young man in a casual, unbuttoned patterned shirt over a plain tee, dark trousers, and stylish sunglasses. Confident, playful swagger.

characters.name: Anandhi
characters.visual_design: Spirited young woman in a vibrant, modern lehenga with traditional jhumka earrings. Expressive, bold, and energetic.

story_beats.title: The Goli Soda Challenge
story_beats.description: On a bustling Chennai street corner, Maari, with a confident smirk, playfully gestures towards Anandhi, initiating a dance challenge.

story_beats.title: The Fiery Response
story_beats.description: Anandhi, with a fiery look, accepts the challenge, striking a dynamic dance pose that mirrors and one-ups his initial move.

story_beats.title: Rowdy Baby Synchronicity
story_beats.description: They come together in a burst of synchronized, high-energy dance, perfectly in sync and laughing as they spin amidst the golden light and lens flares.

story_beats.title: The Final Freeze-Frame
story_beats.description: The dance culminates in a final, iconic freeze-frame pose. Maari dips Anandhi, both looking at the camera with triumphant, joyful expressions as the sunset blazes behind them.

panels.caption: Hey en goli sodaave, en kari kozhambae!
Un kutty puppy naan, take me, take me!
Hey rowdy baby... unnale mood aachu!
One plus one two mama, you plus me free mama!
